what.en: Item 6: the street or mailing address of the entity's principal office, in Texas or anywhere else, abroad included (the form has country and postal-code boxes).
what.zh: 第6项：实体主要办事处的街道或邮寄地址，可在德州或其他任何地方，包括境外（表格设有国家和邮编栏）。

ifNone.en: Give the head office address as it is, including one abroad; it should match the principal office on the company's Texas registration.
ifNone.zh: 如实填写总部地址，境外亦可；应与公司在德州登记的主要办事处地址一致。

confirmations.quote: 6. The entity’s principal office address is: Street or Mailing Address City State Country Postal or Zip Code
Provide the street or mailing address of entity’s principal office.
the street or mailing address of the registrant's principal office in this state or outside this state, as applicable

notes: Form 503 (Revised 09/26), the Secretary of State's Form 503 instructions page and Tex. Bus. & Com. Code 71.102(6). Form 503 has no registered-office line.
